## Overview
### Introduction to Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B
Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a standard, non-open-source model provided by Qwen, released on January 1, 2024. This model boasts an impressive architecture, with a context window of 262,144 tokens and a maximum output of 65,536 tokens. The knowledge cutoff for this model is December 2023, ensuring it has a broad and up-to-date understanding of the world. With capabilities including text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a versatile tool for various applications.

The model is priced at $0.26 per 1M tokens for input and $2.08 per 1M tokens for output, with no charges for cached or batch input.
